why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 has to FAIL because it can only be checked after merge, and the output has to point at pages.yml or the publish-on-push. The output marks line 3 "FAIL". Its evidence says "This can only be checked after merge. .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ to GitHub Pages only on push to main, so at the PR commit the live site still shows the old docs/index.md". That names pages.yml and the publish-on-push trigger. It also suggests a line that can be checked in the PR instead (docs/index.md documents --shout). The wrong_build section makes the same point again. So the trap is caught in full.
